dedupe_keys.name: cds e enabling time critical decision support for disaster response and structural engineering through automated visual data analytics

description: CDS&E: Enabling Time-critical Decision-support for Disaster Response and Structural Engineering through Automated Visual Data Analytics is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Chul Min Yeum, Purdue University (purdue.edu). Each extreme natural disaster is an opportunity to assess the performance of our infrastructure under circumstances that cannot entirely be reproduced in the laboratory or through numerical simulation. When performing reconnaissance in the field, engineers record much of the information being gathered in the form of images. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-r0tv-sv29. Keywords: Natural hazards, image classification, visual data analysis, decision making. Published 2019-07-06. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
